text: We need to review the architecture for Knovra and decide how to structure the repository.

content.text: We decided to adopt ADR-001 for a polyglot monorepo structure with Go runtime, Python context engine, and Rust indexer. The system must maintain invariant #7 for local-first offline execution in services/runtime/cmd/knovra/main.go.

text: The vector database setup failed with exit code 1 due to connection refused on port 5432.

content.text: This was resolved by creating ADR-004 for a resilient hybrid vector store with in-memory offline fallback.
